name: Mac Migrator
summary: Bundles LaunchAgents, shell config, automation folders, brew lists, diagnostics, and restore steps.
story: I have rebuilt the same working environment across too many machines. This turns a Mac migration from oral tradition into an actual written system.

launcher.short: Pack up your Mac for migration
launcher.long: Bundles your Mac's configuration — shell settings, LaunchAgents, background tasks, dotfiles — into a portable archive you can restore on a new machine. Saves hours of reconfiguring from scratch.
